hypotheses.title: Options Gamma Squeeze & Put/Call Sentiment Divergence (Decay 5, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: High put/call open interest ratios (pcr_oi_30) reflect pervasive retail and institutional bearish positioning. When an equity simultaneously trades comfortably above its 30-day put breakeven strike ((close - put_breakeven_30) / close), market makers who sold downside puts are forced to buy underlying shares as spot stabilizes, triggering a structural gamma squeeze. Pure rank spread without non-linear powers delivers balanced weight distribution and ~9% turnover.
confounders: Sudden catastrophic corporate event breaching put breakeven levels overnight
Thin open interest in small-cap equities distorting put/call ratios
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during systemic liquidity runs where put breakeven support floors fail across all sectors.

candidates.expression: group_rank((close - put_breakeven_30) / close, subindustry) - group_rank(pcr_oi_30, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Analyst Uncertainty Resolution & Forecast Disagreement Compression (Decay 5, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Wide dispersion between the highest and lowest sell-side analyst EPS forecasts (anl4_afv4_eps_high - anl4_afv4_eps_low) reflects high fundamental uncertainty, forcing investors to demand an uncertainty discount. Rewarding high consensus median EPS yield while penalizing forecast dispersion isolates equities undergoing institutional uncertainty resolution and multiple re-rating. Low correlation (0.43) against prior portfolio.
confounders: Unusually low analyst coverage resulting in artificially tight forecast ranges
Late-cycle corporate management guidance masking impending earnings downturns
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during macro turning points where analyst consensus estimates lag turning points uniformly.

candidates.expression: group_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_median_eps, 60) / close, subindustry) - group_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_eps_high - anl4_afv4_eps_low, 60) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Sell-Side Net Revision Breadth & Consensus Momentum (Decay 5, Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The net proportion of upward vs downward analyst revisions ((anl4_ady_high - anl4_ady_down) / (upgrades + downgrades + 1)) captures institutional conviction breadth rather than single-firm headline surprises. When net revisions are overwhelmingly positive across competing sell-side brokerages, institutional asset allocators steadily increase weightings. Zero correlation risk (0.05) against the historical database maximizes platform uniqueness.
confounders: Sell-side herd mentality where analysts race to raise targets near market tops
Small-cap equities with only one or two contributing analysts
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during severe market sell-offs where equities with the most recent target upgrades experience the sharpest multiple compression.
